originalIssueDispositions.originalIssue: advise 的末字母是 e。第三人称单数是在原形后加 -s 得到 advises，不能解释为“以 -s 结尾再加 -es”；现有音标正确。
originalIssueDispositions.disposition: advises 是 advise + s，/ɪz/ 词尾。

originalIssueDispositions.originalIssue: “advise 后接动词时用 to do”概括过宽，也与紧接着的 doing 说明矛盾。必须区分 advise sb to do 与 advise doing。
originalIssueDispositions.disposition: advise sb to do 与 advise doing 各列模式。

originalIssueDispositions.originalIssue: 提供专业意见属于常见的建议用法，不宜单独降为生僻义；常用的不及物结构 advise on/about sth 尚未充分覆盖。将其并入 s1，并另外限定原词条“商量”所对应的旧式用法。
originalIssueDispositions.disposition: 专业提供建议并入常用建议义；advise with 由 Dictionary.com 证实且谨慎标较少见，英式 Collins 标 obsolete。

originalIssueDispositions.originalIssue: advise a change 通常表示“建议作出改变”，不能直接作为“告知有变动”的搭配；后者应为 advise sb of a change。
originalIssueDispositions.disposition: 正式通知搭配改为 advise sb of a change。

originalIssueDispositions.originalIssue: “告知”的反向表达不是“表达相反信息”。在是否提供信息这一语境中，可与 withhold information from sb 对照，并说明其有意保留信息的含义。
originalIssueDispositions.disposition: withhold information 只作是否告知的情境对照。

sourceEvidence.text:
=== {{S|étymologie}} ===
: {{ébauche-étym|en}}

=== {{S|verbe|en}} ===
'''advise''' {{pron|æd.ˈvaɪz|en}} {{t|en}}
# [[apprendre|Apprendre]] à, [[informer]], [[renseigner]].
# [[apprendre|Apprendre]] à, [[faire]] [[part]] de.
# [[conseiller|Conseiller]].
#* {{exemple | lang=en
 | The teacher was '''advised''' to take early retirement because his job had taken its toll on his health.
 | Le professeur était conseillé de prendre sa retraite tôt puisque sa profession avait fait des ravages sur sa santé.}}

==== {{S|dérivés}} ====
* {{lien|adviser|en}} (''conseiller'')
* {{lien|advisor|en}} (''conseiller'')

=== {{S|prononciation}} ===
* {{écouter|lang=en|États-Unis <!-- précisez svp la ville ou la région -->|æd.ˈvaɪz|audio=En-us-advise.ogg}}
==== {{S|paronymes}} ====
* {{lien|advice|en}}

[[Catégorie:Verbes de parole en anglais]]

Advise was borrowed from Old French aviser, a verb involving reflection or consideration, related to avis, an opinion. Early English used the verb for considering something before the sense of giving counsel became established. Its history ultimately connects with Latin videre, to see. The English d was a later spelling addition, so an apparent modern ad- division does not explain the borrowing.

[[Catégorie:Verbes de parole en anglais]]

Advise was borrowed from Old French aviser, a verb involving reflection or consideration, related to avis, an opinion. Early English used the verb for considering something before the sense of giving counsel became established. Its history ultimately connects with Latin videre, to see. The English d was a later spelling addition, so an apparent modern ad- division does not explain the borrowing.
